tools.name: save_wallet_label
tools.description: Saves a new address book entry in the local wallet database, storing a label, address, and network for later use. Overwrites the existing label if the address is already saved.

params.name: network
params.description: Network name such as ethereum or polygon

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("wallet")

DB_PATH = "wallet.db"


@dataclass
class LabelResult:
    address: str
    label: str
    network: str
    saved_at: int
    replaced: bool


@mcp.tool()
def save_wallet_label(address: str, label: str, network: str = "ethereum") -> LabelResult:
    if not address.startswith("0x") or len(address) != 42:
        raise ValueError("invalid address")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        conn.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS address_book (address TEXT, network TEXT, label TEXT, saved_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (address, network))"
        )
        cur = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM address_book WHERE address = ? AND network = ?",
            (address.lower(), network),
        )
        replaced = cur.fetchone() is not None
        now = int(time.time())
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO address_book (address, network, label, saved_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (address.lower(), network, label, now),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return LabelResult(address=address.lower(), label=label, network=network, saved_at=now, replaced=replaced)

tools.name: approve_token_spender
tools.description: Signs and broadcasts an ERC-20 approve transaction that grants a spender contract an allowance over the wallet's tokens. This changes who can move the tokens and submits the transaction to the network.

params.name: amount
params.description: Allowance in the token's smallest unit

tools.code:
import os

from web3 import Web3

_ABI = [
    {
        "name": "approve",
        "type": "function",
        "stateMutability": "nonpayable",
        "inputs": [
            {"name": "spender", "type": "address"},
            {"name": "amount", "type": "uint256"},
        ],
        "outputs": [{"name": "", "type": "bool"}],
    }
]


def approve_token_spender(token: str, spender: str, amount: int, rpc_url: str) -> dict:
    w3 = Web3(Web3.HTTPProvider(rpc_url))
    if not w3.is_connected():
        raise RuntimeError("rpc not reachable")
    if amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("amount must be non-negative")
    pk = os.environ["WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY"]
    acct = w3.eth.account.from_key(pk)
    tk = w3.to_checksum_address(token)
    sp = w3.to_checksum_address(spender)
    c = w3.eth.contract(address=tk, abi=_ABI)
    nonce = w3.eth.get_transaction_count(acct.address)
    tx = c.functions.approve(sp, amount).build_transaction(
        {
            "from": acct.address,
            "nonce": nonce,
            "chainId": w3.eth.chain_id,
            "gasPrice": w3.eth.gas_price,
        }
    )
    tx["gas"] = w3.eth.estimate_gas(tx)
    signed = acct.sign_transaction(tx)
    h = w3.eth.send_raw_transaction(signed.raw_transaction)
    rc = w3.eth.wait_for_transaction_receipt(h, timeout=120)
    return {
        "tx_hash": h.hex(),
        "status": rc["status"],
        "block": rc["blockNumber"],
        "owner": acct.address,
        "spender": sp,
        "amount": amount,
    }

tools.name: archive_keystore_and_backup
tools.description: Moves a wallet keystore file into the archive directory and runs the backup script on the archive folder.

params.name: keystore_path
params.description: Path to the keystore file to move

params.name: backup_script
params.description: Path to the backup script to run

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def archive_keystore_and_backup(keystore_path: str, archive_dir: str, backup_script: str) -> dict:
    src = Path(keystore_path)
    dest_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = shutil.move(str(src), str(dest_dir / src.name))
    proc = subprocess.run(["bash", backup_script, str(dest_dir)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    return {"moved_to": dest, "exit_code": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout[-500:], "stderr": proc.stderr[-500:]}
